description_en: Queries the publish status, next hop associated instance type, and whether publishing or withdrawing is allowed for route entries of network instances (VPCs and VBRs) that are loaded into a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance
description_zh: 您可以调用DescribePublishedRouteEntries接口查询已加载到CEN网络实例（VPC和VBR）的各条路由在CEN中的发布状态、路由条目下一跳关联的实例类型、是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网等信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn describe-published-route-entries --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jm0000 --child-instance-id vpc-bp18sth14qii3pnv0000 --child-instance-type VPC --child-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribePublishedRouteEntries

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值为10，取值范围：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values: 

VPC: virtual private cloud.

VBR: virtual border router.

CCN: Cloud Connect Network
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例类型。取值： 

VPC：专有网络。

VBR：边界路由器。

CCN：云连接网
parameters.name: child_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例所属地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: child_instance_region_id

parameters.help_en: The route table ID of the network instance
parameters.name: child_instance_route_table_id

parameters.help_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的路由条目的目标网段
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数

PublishedRouteEntry.description_en: The list of route entry information

ChildInstanceRouteTableId.description_en: The route table ID of the network instance

Conflict.description_en: The list of conflicting route entry information
Conflict.description_zh: 产生冲突的路由条目信息列表

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the conflicting route entry
DestinationCidrBlock.description_zh: 产生冲突的路由条目的目标网段

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the peer network instance that has the route conflict
InstanceId.description_zh: 产生路由冲突的对端的网络实例ID

InstanceType.description_en:
The type of the peer network instance that has the route entry conflict.

VPC: virtual private cloud.
VBR: virtual border router.
CCN: Cloud Connect Network
InstanceType.description_zh:
产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例类型。

VPC：专有网络。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the peer network instance that has the route entry conflict
RegionId.description_zh: 产生路由条目冲突的对端的网络实例所属地域ID

Status.description_en:
The cause of the route entry conflict.

conflict: A conflict caused by route entries that have the same destination CIDR block.  
         
overflow: A conflict caused by the number of route entries in the route table of another network instance exceeding the limit
Status.description_zh:
路由条目产生冲突的原因。

conflict：路由条目的目标网段相同造成的冲突。  
         
overflow：其他网络实例路由表的路由条目数量超出限制造成的冲突。

DestinationCidrBlock.description_en: The destination CIDR block of the route entry

NextHopId.description_en: The instance ID associated with the next hop of the route entry
NextHopId.description_zh: 路由条目下一跳关联的实例ID

NextHopType.description_en:
The type of the instance associated with the next hop of the route entry.

Instance: ECS instance.
HaVip: high-availability virtual IP address.
RouterInterface: router interface.
NetworkInterface: elastic network interface (ENI).
VpnGateway: VPN gateway.
IPv6Gateway: IPv6 gateway.
Ipv4Gateway: IPv4 gateway.
NatGateway: NAT gateway.
Attachment: network instance connection.
service: cloud service.
VBR: virtual border router.
CCN: Cloud Connect Network.
VPC: virtual private cloud.
local: The current route entry is a system route of the network instance and has no next hop.
TR: transit router.
BlackHole: The current route entry is a blackhole route and has no next hop.
EcRouterInterface: Express Connect router interface.
HealthCheck: health check.
AS: Cloud Connect Network access gateway.
classicLink: classic network instance.
GatewayEndpoint: gateway endpoint.
CPE: on-premises data center connected to the virtual border router
NextHopType.description_zh:
路由条目下一跳关联的实例类型。

Instance：ECS实例。
HaVip：高可用虚拟IP。
RouterInterface：路由器接口。
NetworkInterface：弹性网卡。
VpnGateway：VPN网关。
IPv6Gateway：IPv6网关。
Ipv4Gateway：IPv4网关。
NatGateway：NAT网关。
Attachment：网络实例连接。
service：云服务。
VBR：边界路由器。
CCN：云连接网。
VPC：专有网络。
local：表示当前路由条目为网络实例的系统路由，没有下一跳。
TR：转发路由器。
BlackHole：表示当前路由条目为黑洞路由，没有下一跳。
EcRouterInterface：高速通道路由器接口。
HealthCheck：健康检查。
AS：云连接网接入网关。
classicLink：经典网络实例。
GatewayEndpoint：网关终端节点。
CPE：边界路由器连接的本地数据中心

OperationalMode.description_en:
Indicates whether the route is allowed to be published to or withdrawn from CEN.

true: Allowed.

false: Not allowed
OperationalMode.description_zh:
是否允许发布或撤销该路由到云企业网。

true：允许发布或撤销。

false：不允许发布或撤销

PublishStatus.description_en:
The publish status in CEN. Valid values:

Published: Published.

NonPublished: Not published
PublishStatus.description_zh:
在云企业网中的发布状态：

Published：已发布。

NonPublished：未发布

RouteType.description_en:
The type of the route entry.

CEN: The route entry is propagated through CEN.
System: system route.
Custom: custom route
RouteType.description_zh:
路由条目的类型。

CEN：表示通过云企业网传递的路由。
System：表示系统路由。
Custom：表示自定义路由
